description: This Java source file defines the IncomingMessage activity class, which provides UI for posting notifications, including methods to create intent stacks and display app and interstitial notifications with sample messages.

classes.name: IncomingMessage
classes.description: An activity class that displays UI for posting notifications and handles notification creation with sample messages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns click listeners to buttons for showing notifications.

methods.name: makeMessageIntentStack
methods.description: Creates an array of intents representing the activity back stack for notification navigation.

methods.name: showAppNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification with a sample message from 'Joe'.

methods.name: showInterstitialNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays an interstitial notification with a sample message from 'Dianne'.
